about: OME-1545 / PR #1588: the one size contract between url4 attachments and AIGateway's request cap.
A model call carrying url4's largest legal picture, as the Engine really sends it: 'envelope' with
the picture's base64 in the 'picture' slot and prompt_fill repeated in the 'prompt' slot until the
body is exactly the wanted size. Picture bytes: 0..255 repeated, cut to decoded_bytes.
Engine half (byte-identical to the real _ModelEndpoint delivery): apps/screamingface-engine/tests/unit/test_url4_attachment_cap_fits_the_gateway.py
Gateway half (expanded into the real app at its default cap): apps/aigateway/tests/unit/test_url4_attachment_cap_request.py
